params.body:
Mollie is reviewing the pricing page before it takes payments. Several of its answers did not match what the site does or what the terms say.

## What changes

- **Switching plans:** the answer named only the step up. It now covers both directions, as `Subscriptions::change` handles them.
  - Up takes effect at once: the difference for the rest of the month is charged today, and the new price applies from the next payment.
  - Down takes effect when the paid month, or the year on an annual plan, runs out. The plan stays as it is until then.
- **Organisations as the buyer:** the answer and the line under the heading said a subscription was "personal and in your name". Paid plans are sold to organisations (billing details, VAT per buyer). Only the login is personal, as article 3 of the terms says. The meta description drops the same sentence.
- **Currency:** conversion was attributed to the payment provider. A card in another currency is converted by its issuer, and "No surprise fees" could not be promised for that, so it is dropped.
- **New: Is VAT included?** Prices are shown excl. VAT; Belgium pays 21%; an EU organisation outside Belgium with a VAT number is charged none (reverse charge); outside the EU no Belgian VAT applies. This matches `App\Billing\Vat` and article 4 of the terms.
- **New: Do I get an invoice?** Trendwolves NV invoices every payment. It is shown only while billing is live, like the answer on cancelling.

`docs/design/billing.md` no longer lists the pricing line as open. The mismatches in the terms themselves stay open: that is Trendwolves' text.

## Tests

- Two new `PricingTermsTest` cases: one for the switching answer, one for the buyer, VAT and currency wording.
- Full suite: 592 of 593 pass. The one failure is `BuildStampTest`, which fails in every worktree because it reads the checkout's own build stamp. Pint clean.
params.title: Pricing answers: both ways of switching, VAT, invoices, organisations as the buyer
